[T1] Laser training must be renewed every 12 months. A current training record is required before operating the laser.

items.text:
No. A graduate student may not operate the laser alone at 19:00: two trained people must be present whenever the laser operates, including during general laboratory access hours. [A2]

Training must be renewed every 12 months, and a current training record is required before operation. Calling the student “trained” does not establish that their record is current. [T1]

Separately, the passages do not specify general laboratory access hours, so they do not establish whether 19:00 is within permitted access hours.

Claim check:

- Two trained people must be present during laser operation, including during general access hours — [A2].
- Solo operation at 19:00 is prohibited — [A2].
- Training renewal is required every 12 months, with a current record before operation — [T1].
- This student has a current training record — unsupported.
- 19:00 falls within permitted access hours — unsupported; access hours are not supplied.
